# SARIF rules

`relgap outdated --format sarif`, `relgap drift --format sarif` and `relgap audit --format sarif` write
SARIF 2.1.0 for GitHub code scanning. Each log lists the rules below, and every result points at the
pin's file and line.

| Rule | Level | Commands | Description | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `breaking` | note | [outdated](/cli/outdated) | The upgrade to the latest version has breaking changes. The release notes from the pinned version to the latest version have entries classified as breaking at or above --min-confidence. | Read the digest the message names before you upgrade the pin. |
| `deprecation` | note | [outdated](/cli/outdated) | The upgrade to the latest version has deprecations. The release notes from the pinned version to the latest version have entries classified as deprecations at or above --min-confidence. | Read the digest the message names and move off the deprecated features before they go away. |
| `eol` | error | [outdated](/cli/outdated) | The pinned release cycle has reached its end of life. endoflife.date lists the release cycle of the pinned version as end of life, so it gets no more fixes. | Upgrade the pin to a supported release cycle. |
| `outdated` | warning | [outdated](/cli/outdated) | The pin is behind the latest version. A newer stable version is out on the pin's release line. | Upgrade the pin; relgap digest lists what changed in between. |
| `failed` | error | [outdated](/cli/outdated), [drift](/cli/drift), [audit](/cli/audit) | relgap couldn't check this pin or file. A file didn't parse, or looking up the tool's versions failed. | Fix the file, or run relgap again with -v to see the failing request. |
| `unchecked` | note | [outdated](/cli/outdated), [audit](/cli/audit) | relgap didn't check this pin for vulnerabilities. OSV wasn't asked about the pinned version, so no result here doesn't mean the version is clean. The message gives the reason: no-advisory-source, private-source, not-exact, unresolved, offline or failed. | Pin an exact version, or check the tool another way. Details: https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/concepts/enrichment#unchecked-pins |
| `drift` | warning | [drift](/cli/drift) | The pin differs from the version most repositories pin. The scanned repositories pin more than one version of the tool, and this pin stands for a version other than the one most of them pin. | Pin the version most repositories use, or add an ignore rule for this path in .relgap.yaml. |

## Vulnerabilities

outdated and audit add one rule per OSV advisory that affects a pinned version, with the OSV ID as
the rule ID. Its level comes from the advisory's CVSS rating: error for high and critical, warning for
medium, and note for low or no rating. The rule carries the score as `security-severity`, which
code scanning shows as the alert's severity, and its help links to the advisory on osv.dev.

## Fingerprints

Every result has the partial fingerprint `relgapFinding/v1`, built from the rule, the tool, the file and
what the result is about. GitHub ignores it and hashes the pin's line itself; other SARIF readers can
match results across runs with it.
